properties.displayName: Dumping LSASS Process Into a File
properties.description:
Adversaries may attempt to access credential material stored in the process memory of the Local Security Authority Subsystem Service (LSASS).
After a user logs on, the system generates and stores a variety of credential materials in LSASS process memory.
These credential materials can be harvested by an administrative user or system and used to conduct lateral movement using alternate authentication materials.
As well as in-memory techniques, the LSASS process memory can be dumped from the target host and analyzed on a local system.
Ref: https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1003/001/
properties.query:
Event
| where EventLog =~ "Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational" and EventID==10
| parse EventData with * 'TargetImage">' TargetImage "<" * 'GrantedAccess">' GrantedAccess "<" * 'CallTrace">' CallTrace "<" * 
| where GrantedAccess =~ "0x1FFFFF" and TargetImage =~ "C:\\Windows\\System32\\lsass.exe" and CallTrace has_any ("dbghelp.dll","dbgcore.dll")
| parse EventData with * 'SourceProcessGUID">' SourceProcessGUID "<" * 'SourceImage">' SourceImage "<" *
| summarize StartTime = min(TimeGenerated), EndTime = max(TimeGenerated) by EventID, Computer, SourceProcessGUID, SourceImage, GrantedAccess, TargetImage, CallTrace
| extend HostName = iif(Computer has '.',substring(Computer,0,indexof(Computer,'.')),Computer) , DnsDomain = iif(Computer has '.',substring(Computer,indexof(Computer,'.')+1),'')

watchlist. The watchlist deployed as part of the Dynamics 355 Continuous Threat
Montioring Solution contains common security configuration related changes and
can be modified to tune which events generate an alert.

properties.description:
Identifies User configuration changes made done in the D365 like Add/Removing
Business Units, Teams, Enable/Disable Users, Change the Access Mode field for
any user in the "D365-UserConfig" watchlist. The watchlist deployed as part of
the Dynamics 355 Continuous Threat Montioring Solution contains common security
configuration related changes and can be modified to tune which events generate
an alert.
properties.query:
// =============================================================
// Sentinel Alert : D365 Privileged User Configuration Changes (FULLY ENRICHED)
// =============================================================
let DetectionWindow = 1d;
let EnrichmentWindow = 30d;
// --- Excluded service / automation accounts ---
let ExcludedAccounts = dynamic([
  "CDSUserManagement@onmicrosoft.com",
  "D365.DataMigration@creditsafe.com",
  "D365LCSProductionOwner@creditsafe.com",
  "Divakar.Jakkani@creditsafe.com",
  "Pragna.Kalahastrireddy@creditsafe.com",
  "Saivenkat.Ambabasu@creditsafe.com",
  "Saketh.Dvs@creditsafe.com"
]);
// --- Active rules from watchlist ---
let ActiveRules =
    _GetWatchlist('D365-UserConfig')
    | project 
        Event         = tolower(trim(@"\s+", tostring(column_ifexists("Event", "")))),
        WatchlistRule = tostring(column_ifexists("Comment", "")),
        IsEnable      = tostring(column_ifexists("IsEnable", "")),
        Field         = tostring(column_ifexists("Field", ""))
    | where IsEnable == "1"
    | project Event, WatchlistRule, Field;
// --- Role Lookup (Aggressive Name Resolution) ---
let RoleLookup = materialize(
    Dynamics365Activity
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(EnrichmentWindow)
    | extend 
        Entity = tostring(column_ifexists("EntityName", "")),
        RecName = tostring(column_ifexists("RecordName", "")),
        RecId = tolower(trim(@"\s+", tostring(column_ifexists("RecordId", ""))))
    | where Entity =~ "role" 
    | where isnotempty(RecId) and isnotempty(RecName)
    | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, RecName) by RoleId = RecId
    | project RoleId, ResolvedRoleName = RecName
);
// --- User Lookup (Aggressive Name Resolution) ---
let UserLookup = materialize(
    Dynamics365Activity
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(EnrichmentWindow)
    | extend 
        Entity = tostring(column_ifexists("EntityName", "")),
        RecName = tostring(column_ifexists("RecordName", "")),
        RecId = tolower(trim(@"\s+", tostring(column_ifexists("RecordId", ""))))
    | where Entity =~ "systemuser" 
    | where isnotempty(RecId) and isnotempty(RecName)
    | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, RecName) by TargetUserId = RecId
    | project TargetUserId, ResolvedUserName = RecName
);
// =============================================================
// Main Detection Logic
// =============================================================
Dynamics365Activity
| where TimeGenerated > ago(DetectionWindow)
| where UserId !in (ExcludedAccounts)
| where isnotempty(OriginalObjectId)
| extend JoinEventId = tolower(trim(@"\s+", tostring(OriginalObjectId)))
// Join to your specific Watchlist configuration
| join kind=inner (ActiveRules) on $left.JoinEventId == $right.Event
| extend D365Message = coalesce(
    tostring(column_ifexists("Message", "")),
    tostring(column_ifexists("Message1", "")),
    tostring(column_ifexists("Message2", ""))
)
| extend D365Operation = coalesce(
    tostring(column_ifexists("OperationName", "")),
    tostring(column_ifexists("ActionType", "")),
    D365Message
)
// Filter for the field you are monitoring (e.g. "role")
| where tostring(Fields) has Field
| extend FieldsJson = todynamic(Fields)
| mv-expand FieldsJson
| extend 
    KVName  = tolower(tostring(FieldsJson.Name)),
    KVValue = tolower(trim(@"\s+", tostring(FieldsJson.Value)))
// Group back to unique activity events
| summarize 
    ExtractedTargetUserId = maxif(KVValue, KVName == "systemuser"),
    ExtractedRoleId       = maxif(KVValue, KVName == "role"),
    SchemaName            = maxif(KVValue, KVName == "schemaname"),
    OriginalFields        = any(tostring(Fields))
  by 
    TimeGenerated, JoinEventId, WatchlistRule, Field, UserId, 
    ClientIP, InstanceUrl, UserAgent, D365Message, D365Operation
// --- Step 1: Join Enrichment Lookups ---
| join kind=leftouter (RoleLookup) on $left.ExtractedRoleId == $right.RoleId
| join kind=leftouter (UserLookup) on $left.ExtractedTargetUserId == $right.TargetUserId
// --- Step 2: Normalize Variables (Prevents Scalar Errors) ---
| extend 
    ActorUPN   = UserId,
    Environment = tostring(split(split(InstanceUrl, "://")[1], ".")[0]),
    ChangeType = case(
        tolower(D365Message) has "disassociate" or tolower(D365Operation) has "disassociate", "Role REMOVED",
        tolower(D365Message) has "associate"    or tolower(D365Operation) has "associate",    "Role ASSIGNED",
        "Configuration CHANGED"
    ),
    FinalRoleName = coalesce(ResolvedRoleName, strcat("GUID:", ExtractedRoleId)),
    FinalUserName = coalesce(ResolvedUserName, strcat("GUID:", ExtractedTargetUserId))
// --- Step 3: Final Summary (Analyst Narrative) ---
| extend Summary = strcat(
    "User '", ActorUPN, "' performed a ", 
    tolower(ChangeType), " (Role: '", FinalRoleName, 
    "') for Target User: '", FinalUserName, 
    "' in the '", Environment, "' environment."
)
// --- Final Project for Sentinel ---
| project
    TimeGenerated,
    Summary,             // Primary narrative for the analyst
    ChangeType,
    ActorUPN,            // The user performing the change
    TargetUser = FinalUserName,
    RoleName   = FinalRoleName,
    Environment,
    AlertRule  = WatchlistRule,
    ChangedField = Field,
    D365Operation,
    D365Message,
    OriginalObjectId = JoinEventId,
    ClientIP,
    InstanceUrl,
    UserAgent,
    Fields = OriginalFields
| sort by TimeGenerated desc

properties.description:

Detects suspicious OAuth consent grants or delegated permission additions that may indicate
consent phishing or application abuse. Attackers commonly use consent-grant abuse to gain
access to mail, files, SharePoint, Teams, or other SaaS data without requiring traditional
credential theft.

Investigate the actor, target application, requested permissions, consent type, and whether
the activity was expected and approved.
properties.query:
let ApprovedApps =
    _GetWatchlist('OAuthApprovedApplications')
    | project TargetApp = SearchKey;
let OAuthEvents =
AuditLogs
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(1h)
| where OperationName in~ (
    "Consent to application",
    "Add delegated permission grant",
    "Add app role assignment to service principal"
)
| extend InitiatedByJson = parse_json(tostring(InitiatedBy))
| extend
    ActorUPN = tostring(InitiatedByJson.user.userPrincipalName),
    ActorIP = tostring(InitiatedByJson.user.ipAddress),
    ActorDisplayName = tostring(InitiatedByJson.user.displayName)
| where not(
    ActorUPN in~ (
        "Nathan.Browning-Admin@creditsafe.com",
        "adam.calvert-admin@creditsafe.com",
        "andrew-allen@creditsafe.com",
        "emma.ingram-admin@creditsafe.com",
        "barry.andrews-admin@creditsafe.com"
    )
)
| mv-expand TargetResources
| extend
    TargetApp = tostring(TargetResources.displayName),
    TargetType = tostring(TargetResources.type),
    TargetId = tostring(TargetResources.id)
| mv-expand ModifiedProperties = TargetResources.modifiedProperties
| extend
    PropertyName = tostring(ModifiedProperties.displayName),
    PropertyValue = trim('"', tostring(ModifiedProperties.newValue))
| summarize
    Properties = make_bag(pack(PropertyName, PropertyValue))
  by
    TimeGenerated,
    OperationName,
    CorrelationId,
    Result,
    ActorUPN,
    ActorIP,
    ActorDisplayName,
    TargetApp,
    TargetType,
    TargetId
| extend
    Scope = tostring(Properties["DelegatedPermissionGrant.Scope"]),
    ConsentType = tostring(Properties["DelegatedPermissionGrant.ConsentType"]),
    ConsentPermissions = tostring(Properties["ConsentAction.Permissions"]),
    IsAdminConsent = tostring(Properties["ConsentContext.IsAdminConsent"])
| extend Severity =
    case(
        Scope has "Directory.ReadWrite.All", "High",
        Scope has "Application.ReadWrite.All", "High",
        Scope has "RoleManagement.ReadWrite.Directory", "High",
        Scope has "AppRoleAssignment.ReadWrite.All", "High",
        Scope has "DelegatedPermissionGrant.ReadWrite.All", "High",
        ConsentType =~ "AllPrincipals"
            and Scope has "Directory.Read.All", "High",
        ConsentType =~ "AllPrincipals"
            and Scope has "Mail.Read", "High",
        ConsentType =~ "AllPrincipals"
            and Scope has "Files.Read.All", "High",
        ConsentType =~ "AllPrincipals"
            and Scope has "Sites.Read.All", "High",
        ConsentType =~ "AllPrincipals"
            and Scope has "OnlineMeetingTranscript.Read.All", "High",
        Scope has "Files.ReadWrite.All", "Medium",
        Scope has "Mail.ReadWrite", "Medium",
        Scope has "Mail.Send", "Medium",
        Scope has "MailboxSettings.ReadWrite", "Medium",
        Scope has "EWS.AccessAsUser.All", "Medium",
        ConsentType =~ "AllPrincipals"
            and Scope has_any (
                "offline_access",
                "User.Read.All",
                "Mail.Read",
                "Files.Read.All",
                "Sites.Read.All",
                "Directory.Read.All"
            ), "Medium",
        IsAdminConsent =~ "True", "Medium",
        "Low"
    )
| extend SuspiciousReason =
    case(
        Scope has "Directory.ReadWrite.All",
            "Application granted directory write permissions",
        Scope has "Application.ReadWrite.All",
            "Application granted application management permissions",
        Scope has "RoleManagement.ReadWrite.Directory",
            "Application granted role management permissions",
        ConsentType =~ "AllPrincipals"
            and Scope has "Directory.Read.All",
            "Tenant-wide directory access granted",
        ConsentType =~ "AllPrincipals"
            and Scope has "Mail.Read",
            "Tenant-wide mailbox access granted",
        ConsentType =~ "AllPrincipals"
            and Scope has "Files.Read.All",
            "Tenant-wide SharePoint access granted",
        ConsentType =~ "AllPrincipals"
            and Scope has "Sites.Read.All",
            "Tenant-wide SharePoint site access granted",
        ConsentType =~ "AllPrincipals"
            and Scope has "OnlineMeetingTranscript.Read.All",
            "Tenant-wide Teams transcript access granted",
        Scope has "offline_access",
            "Application granted persistent access",
        "OAuth consent observed"
    )
| where Severity != "Low";
let HighSeverityEvents =
OAuthEvents
| where Severity == "High";
let MediumSeverityEvents =
OAuthEvents
| where Severity == "Medium"
| join kind=leftanti ApprovedApps on TargetApp;
union HighSeverityEvents, MediumSeverityEvents
| project
    TimeGenerated,
    Severity,
    SuspiciousReason,
    ActorUPN,
    ActorDisplayName,
    ActorIP,
    OperationName,
    TargetApp,
    TargetType,
    Scope,
    ConsentType,
    IsAdminConsent,
    ConsentPermissions,
    CorrelationId,
    Result

Detects PowerShell execution patterns commonly associated with malware staging and execution,
including Invoke-WebRequest, DownloadString, IEX, Start-BitsTransfer, and similar download
techniques. This is a strong indicator of script-based execution and often precedes follow-on
compromise activity such as payload retrieval, credential theft, or persistence.
properties.query:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(1d)
| where FileName in~ ("powershell.exe", "pwsh.exe", "powershell_ise.exe")
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("Invoke-WebRequest", "DownloadString", "Start-BitsTransfer", "IEX", "wget ", "curl ", "certutil", "bitsadmin")
| where not(InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("devenv.exe", "Code.exe", "cursor.exe"))
| where not(InitiatingProcessCommandLine has_any ("Visual Studio", "Cursor", "vscode", "devenv", "code ", "cursor "))
| extend DownloadMethod = case(
    ProcessCommandLine has "Invoke-WebRequest", "Invoke-WebRequest",
    ProcessCommandLine has "DownloadString", "DownloadString",
    ProcessCommandLine has "Start-BitsTransfer", "Start-BitsTransfer",
    ProcessCommandLine has "IEX", "IEX",
    "Other")
| extend AccountUpn = iff(isempty(tostring(InitiatingProcessAccountUpn)), tostring(AccountUpn), tostring(InitiatingProcessAccountUpn))
| project TimeGenerated, DeviceName, AccountUpn, DownloadMethod, ProcessCommandLine, SHA1

properties.displayName: [InitialAccess] CVE-2026-42897 Exchange OWA XSS Exploitation Attempt
properties.description:
DO NOT EDIT IN PORTAL - MANAGED VIA GIT REPO.

Detects potential exploitation attempts of CVE-2026-42897, a critical cross-site scripting
vulnerability in Microsoft Exchange Server Outlook Web Access (OWA). An attacker can send
a specially crafted email that, when opened in OWA, executes arbitrary JavaScript in the
victim's browser context.

References:
- https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-42897
- CVSS Score: 8.1 (Critical)
- Patch released: June 9, 2026
- Initial EM service mitigation: May 14, 2026
properties.query:
let ExchangeOWAPaths = dynamic(["/owa/", "/ecp/", "/autodiscover/", "/mapi/", "/ews/"]);
let SuspiciousPatterns = dynamic(["<script", "javascript:", "onerror=", "onload=", "eval(", "document.cookie", "XMLHttpRequest", "%3cscript", "%3Cscript", "<script"]);
DeviceEvents
| where ActionType in ("BrowserLaunchedToOpenUrl", "SmartScreenUrlWarning", "NetworkConnectionInspected")
| where InitiatingProcessFileName has_any ("msedge.exe", "chrome.exe", "firefox.exe", "iexplore.exe")
| where RemoteUrl has_any (ExchangeOWAPaths)
| extend UrlLower = tolower(RemoteUrl)
| where UrlLower has_any (SuspiciousPatterns)
| extend CVE = "CVE-2026-42897"
| extend ThreatDescription = "Potential CVE-2026-42897 Exchange OWA XSS exploitation attempt detected"
| project TimeGenerated, DeviceName, DeviceId, AccountName, AccountDomain, InitiatingProcessFileName,
          InitiatingProcessCommandLine, RemoteUrl, RemoteIP, ActionType, CVE, ThreatDescription
| union (
    DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where RemoteUrl has_any (ExchangeOWAPaths)
    | extend UrlLower = tolower(RemoteUrl)
    | where UrlLower has_any (SuspiciousPatterns)
    | extend CVE = "CVE-2026-42897"
    | extend ThreatDescription = "Potential CVE-2026-42897 Exchange OWA XSS exploitation attempt detected via network event"
    | project TimeGenerated, DeviceName, DeviceId, InitiatingProcessAccountName, InitiatingProcessAccountDomain,
              InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine, RemoteUrl,
              RemoteIP, ActionType = "NetworkEvent", CVE, ThreatDescription
)

properties.description:
DO NOT EDIT IN PORTAL - MANAGED VIA GIT REPO.

Detects user accounts being added to critical on-premises Active Directory groups.
properties.query:
SecurityEvent
| where EventID in (4728, 4732, 4756)
| extend ActorAccount = tostring(SubjectUserName)
| extend ActorDomain = tostring(SubjectDomainName)
| extend AddedAccountRaw = tostring(MemberName)
| extend TargetGroupRaw = tostring(TargetUserName)
| extend TargetDomainRaw = tostring(TargetDomainName)
| extend EventIdStr = tostring(EventID)
| extend AddedAccount = extract("CN=([^,]+)", 1, AddedAccountRaw)
| extend AddedAccount = iff(isempty(AddedAccount), AddedAccountRaw, AddedAccount)
| extend GroupScope = case(EventID == 4728, "Global", EventID == 4732, "Local", EventID == 4756, "Universal", "Other")
| where TargetGroupRaw in~ ("ITSUPPORT","Enterprise Admins","Domain Admins","Administrators")
| where (TargetDomainRaw =~ "CSUK" or Computer has "csuk.creditsafe.com" or WorkstationName has "csuk.creditsafe.com" or TargetGroupRaw =~ "Administrators")
| where isnotempty(AddedAccount) and AddedAccount != "-" and AddedAccount !~ "Anonymous"
| extend GroupIdentifier = strcat(TargetDomainRaw, @"", TargetGroupRaw)
| extend FullActorAccount = strcat(ActorDomain, @"", ActorAccount)
| project TimeGenerated, AddedAccount, FullActorAccount, ActorAccount, ActorDomain, TargetGroupRaw, GroupIdentifier, GroupScope, EventIdStr, Computer, WorkstationName

properties.description:

Detects user accounts being removed from critical on-premises Active Directory groups.
properties.query:
SecurityEvent
| where EventID in (4729, 4733, 4757)
| extend ActorAccount = tostring(SubjectUserName)
| extend ActorDomain = tostring(SubjectDomainName)
| extend RemovedAccountRaw = tostring(MemberName)
| extend TargetGroupRaw = tostring(TargetUserName)
| extend TargetDomainRaw = tostring(TargetDomainName)
| extend EventIdStr = tostring(EventID)
| extend RemovedAccount = extract("CN=([^,]+)", 1, RemovedAccountRaw)
| extend RemovedAccount = iff(isempty(RemovedAccount), RemovedAccountRaw, RemovedAccount)
| extend GroupScope = case(EventID == 4729, "Global", EventID == 4733, "Local", EventID == 4757, "Universal", "Other")
| where TargetGroupRaw in~ ("ITSUPPORT","Enterprise Admins","Domain Admins","Administrators")
| where (TargetDomainRaw =~ "CSUK" or Computer has "csuk.creditsafe.com" or WorkstationName has "csuk.creditsafe.com" or TargetGroupRaw =~ "Administrators")
| where isnotempty(RemovedAccount) and RemovedAccount != "-" and RemovedAccount !~ "Anonymous"
| extend GroupIdentifier = strcat(TargetDomainRaw, @"", TargetGroupRaw)
| extend FullActorAccount = strcat(ActorDomain, @"", ActorAccount)
| project TimeGenerated, RemovedAccount, FullActorAccount, ActorAccount, ActorDomain, TargetGroupRaw, GroupIdentifier, GroupScope, EventIdStr, Computer, WorkstationName

SecurityEvent 4624 with LogonType 10.

Direct RDP access to domain controllers should be rare and tightly controlled.

IdentityInfo
|summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by SAMAccountName
|project SAMAccountName,AccountDisplayName,JobTitle;

| where LogonType == 10
| extend SourceHost = tostring(WorkstationName)
| extend TargetUser = tostring(TargetUserName)
| extend SourceIP = tostring(IpAddress)
| where isnotempty(TargetUser)
| where TargetUser != "ANONYMOUS LOGON"
| where not(TargetUser endswith "$")
| join kind=leftouter Identitysnap on $left.TargetUser == $right.SAMAccountName

properties.description:
DO NOT EDIT IN PORTAL - MANAGED VIA GIT REPO.
Detects successful Microsoft Entra Privileged Identity Management (PIM) role activations where the account has not activated the same role within the previous 14 days.
This rule uses mv-apply to dynamically extract role names, avoiding fragile TargetResources index references.
properties.query:
let LookbackWindow = 14d;
let RecentWindow = 1d;
let NormalizeText = (Input:string) {
    tolower(trim(" ", tostring(Input)))
};
let IdentityLookup =
    IdentityInfo
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
    | where isnotempty(AccountUPN) or isnotempty(AccountObjectId)
    | extend NormalisedIdentityUPN = NormalizeText(AccountUPN)
    | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by NormalisedIdentityUPN
    | project
        NormalisedIdentityUPN,
        IdentityAccountName = AccountName,
        IdentityUPN = AccountUPN,
        IdentityDisplayName = AccountDisplayName,
        AccountSID,
        IdentityAccountObjectId = AccountObjectId,
        Department,
        JobTitle,
        Manager,
        IsAccountEnabled,
        IsServiceAccount;
let PIMActivations =
    AuditLogs
    | where TimeGenerated >= ago(LookbackWindow)
    | where OperationName =~ "Add member to role completed (PIM activation)"
    | where Result =~ "success"
    | extend
        InitiatingAppName = tostring(InitiatedBy.app.displayName),
        InitiatingAppServicePrincipalId = tostring(InitiatedBy.app.servicePrincipalId),
        InitiatingUserPrincipalName = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName),
        InitiatingAadUserId = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.id),
        InitiatingUserIP = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.ipAddress),
        TargetResourcesDynamic = todynamic(TargetResources)
    | mv-expand TargetResource = TargetResourcesDynamic
    | extend
        TargetResourceType = tostring(TargetResource.type),
        TargetResourceDisplayName = tostring(TargetResource.displayName),
        TargetResourceUPN = tostring(TargetResource.userPrincipalName),
        TargetResourceId = tostring(TargetResource.id),
        ModifiedProperties = TargetResource.modifiedProperties
    | mv-apply Prop = ModifiedProperties on (
        where tostring(Prop.displayName) in ("Role.DisplayName", "RoleDefinition.DisplayName", "RoleDefinitionName", "RoleName", "DirectoryRole")
        | extend RoleFromProp = trim(@"[\[\]""\s]+", tostring(Prop.newValue))
    )
    | extend ElevatedRole = coalesce(RoleFromProp, iff(TargetResourceType in ("Role", "DirectoryRole"), TargetResourceDisplayName, ""))
    | where isnotempty(ElevatedRole) and ElevatedRole !~ "Member"
    | extend
        UserPrincipalName = tostring(TargetResourceUPN),
        NormalisedUserPrincipalName = NormalizeText(tostring(TargetResourceUPN)),
        NormalisedElevatedRole = NormalizeText(ElevatedRole)
    | where isnotempty(NormalisedUserPrincipalName)
    | extend Justification = coalesce(tostring(ResultReason), "No justification recorded");
let HistoricalActivations =
    PIMActivations
    | where TimeGenerated between (ago(LookbackWindow) .. ago(RecentWindow))
    | summarize by NormalisedUserPrincipalName, NormalisedElevatedRole;
let RecentActivations =
    PIMActivations
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(RecentWindow);
RecentActivations
| join kind=leftanti HistoricalActivations on NormalisedUserPrincipalName, NormalisedElevatedRole
| summarize
    FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated),
    LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated),
    EventCount = count(),
    SourceIPSet = make_set(InitiatingUserIP, 10),
    take_any(*)
    by NormalisedUserPrincipalName, NormalisedElevatedRole
| join kind=leftouter IdentityLookup on $left.NormalisedUserPrincipalName == $right.NormalisedIdentityUPN
| extend
    UserPrincipalName = coalesce(UserPrincipalName, IdentityUPN),
    AccountName = tostring(split(UserPrincipalName, "@")[0]),
    UPNSuffix = tostring(split(UserPrincipalName, "@")[1]),
    DisplayName = coalesce(IdentityDisplayName, TargetResourceDisplayName, UserPrincipalName),
    AccountObjectId = coalesce(TargetResourceId, IdentityAccountObjectId),
    SourceIPs = strcat_array(SourceIPSet, ", "),
    TimespanMinutes = datetime_diff("minute", LastSeen, FirstSeen),
    IdentityMatchStatus = iff(isnotempty(IdentityUPN), "Matched", "No Match"),
    InitiatingAccountName = tostring(split(InitiatingUserPrincipalName, "@")[0]),
    InitiatingUPNSuffix = tostring(split(InitiatingUserPrincipalName, "@")[1]),
    ElevatedBy = iff(isnotempty(InitiatingUserPrincipalName), InitiatingUserPrincipalName, InitiatingAppName)
| project
    TimeGenerated = LastSeen,
    AccountName,
    DisplayName,
    UserPrincipalName,
    UPNSuffix,
    ElevatedRole,
    ElevatedBy,
    InitiatingUserPrincipalName,
    InitiatingAccountName,
    InitiatingUPNSuffix,
    InitiatingAadUserId,
    SourceIPs,
    Justification,
    EventCount,
    FirstSeen,
    LastSeen,
    TimespanMinutes,
    IdentityMatchStatus,
    Department,
    JobTitle,
    Manager,
    AccountSID,
    AccountObjectId,
    IsAccountEnabled,
    IsServiceAccount,
    Result,
    Id,
    CorrelationId

properties.description:
Detects an account that is elevated to a new role where that account has not had that role in the last 14 days.
  Role elevations are a key mechanism for gaining permissions, monitoring which users have which roles, and for anomalies in those roles is useful for finding suspicious activity.
  Ref: https://docs.microsoft.com/azure/active-directory/fundamentals/security-operations-privileged-accounts#changes-to-privileged-accounts
properties.query:
let auditList =
AuditLogs
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(14d)
| where OperationName =~ "Add member to role completed (PIM activation)"
| where Result =~ "success"
| extend TargetUserPrincipalName = tostring(TargetResources[2].userPrincipalName)
| extend displayName = tostring(TargetResources[0].displayName)
| extend displayName2 = tostring(TargetResources[3].displayName)
| extend ElevatedRole = iif(displayName =~ "Member", displayName2, displayName)
;
let lookbackList = auditList
| where TimeGenerated between(ago(14d)..ago(1d))
;
let recentList = auditList
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
;
let newlyElevated = recentList
| join kind = leftanti lookbackList on ElevatedRole, TargetUserPrincipalName
;
newlyElevated | project Id, AdditionalDetails
| mv-expand bagexpansion=array AdditionalDetails
| evaluate bag_unpack(AdditionalDetails)
| extend key = column_ifexists("key", ''), value = column_ifexists("value", '')
| evaluate pivot(key, make_set(value))
| extend ipaddr = todynamic(column_ifexists("ipaddr", ""))
| mv-expand ipaddr
| project Id, InitiatingIPAddress = tostring(ipaddr)
| join kind=rightouter newlyElevated on Id
| extend InitiatingAppName = tostring(InitiatedBy.app.displayName)
| extend InitiatingAppServicePrincipalId = tostring(InitiatedBy.app.servicePrincipalId)
| extend InitiatingUserPrincipalName = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName)
| extend InitiatingAadUserId = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.id)
| extend InitiatingIPAddress = iff(isnotempty(tostring(InitiatedBy.user.ipAddress)), tostring(InitiatedBy.user.ipAddress), InitiatingIPAddress)
| extend ElevatedBy = iff(isnotempty(InitiatingUserPrincipalName), InitiatingUserPrincipalName, InitiatingAppName)
| extend ElevatedUser = TargetUserPrincipalName
| extend InitiatingAccountName = tostring(split(InitiatingUserPrincipalName, "@")[0]), InitiatingAccountUPNSuffix = tostring(split(InitiatingUserPrincipalName, "@")[1])
| extend TargetAccountName = tostring(split(TargetUserPrincipalName, "@")[0]), TargetAccountUPNSuffix = tostring(split(TargetUserPrincipalName, "@")[1])
| project-reorder ElevatedUser, ElevatedRole, ResultReason, ElevatedBy, InitiatingUserPrincipalName, InitiatingAadUserId, InitiatingIPAddress, TargetUserPrincipalName

properties.displayName: [Persistence] Expired Password NTLM Authentication Attempt Spike
properties.description:
DO NOT EDIT IN PORTAL - MANAGED VIA GIT REPO.

Detects repeated NTLM authentication attempts using expired passwords via
SecurityEvent 4776.

Event ID 4776 indicates that a domain controller attempted to validate
credentials for an account. Status code 0xc0000071 indicates that the
supplied password has expired.

This rule identifies accounts generating a spike of NTLM authentication
failures due to expired password status. This often indicates stale credentials
being used by misconfigured services, scheduled tasks, scripts, mapped drives,
applications, or other automated processes. In some cases, it may also indicate
attempted use of previously compromised credentials after the account password
has expired.

The query enriches the raw SAMAccountName from the domain controller event
with IdentityInfo by joining against IdentityInfo.SAMAccountName. The join is
case-insensitive and removes a trailing "-a" suffix from the account name where
present, so values such as "user-a", "USER-A", and "user" are treated as the
same identity.

Analyst investigation steps:
  1. Review the enriched AccountName, DisplayName, UserPrincipalName, Department,
     JobTitle, and Manager fields to identify the affected user or account owner.
  2. Check RawSAMAccountName and NormalisedSAM to confirm whether the alert was
     generated by a standard user account or an alternate/admin-style account.
  3. Review AttemptCount, HostCount, SrcHosts, FirstSeen, and LastSeen to understand
     the scale, source spread, and duration of the activity.
  4. If the source host is known, investigate the device for stale saved credentials,
     scheduled tasks, services, mapped drives, scripts, legacy applications, or
     cached sessions using the expired password.
  5. Confirm whether the activity aligns with a recent password expiry, password
     reset, account migration, or known support activity.
  6. If the activity is not expected, review the affected account for suspicious
     authentication activity, recent password changes, abnormal source systems,
     and possible misuse of previously known credentials.
  7. If a stale credential source is confirmed, work with the device/application
     owner to update or remove the stored credential and monitor for recurrence.
properties.query:
// Detect repeated NTLM authentication attempts using expired passwords.
// Event ID 4776 = The domain controller attempted to validate the credentials for an account.
// Status 0xc0000071 = User logon with expired password.
//
// Enrichment:
// - Takes TargetUserName from SecurityEvent as the raw SAMAccountName.
// - Normalises case.
// - Strips a trailing "-a" suffix from both the SecurityEvent account and IdentityInfo SAMAccountName.
// - Joins to IdentityInfo.SAMAccountName to return clearer user context.
let NormalizeSam = (Account:string) {
    replace_regex(
        tolower(trim(" ", tostring(Account))),
        @"-a$",
        ""
    )
};
let IdentityLookup =
    IdentityInfo
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
    | where isnotempty(SAMAccountName)
    | extend NormalisedIdentitySAM = NormalizeSam(SAMAccountName)
    | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by NormalisedIdentitySAM
    | project
        NormalisedIdentitySAM,
        IdentitySAMAccountName = SAMAccountName,
        IdentityAccountName = AccountName,
        IdentityUPN = AccountUPN,
        IdentityDisplayName = AccountDisplayName,
        IdentityDomain = AccountDomain,
        MailAddress,
        Manager,
        Department,
        JobTitle,
        AccountSID,
        AccountObjectId,
        IsAccountEnabled,
        IsServiceAccount,
        SourceSystem;
SecurityEvent
| where EventID == 4776
| extend RawSAMAccountName = tostring(TargetUserName)
| extend FailureCode = tostring(Status)
| extend SourceHost = iff(isempty(tostring(WorkstationName)), "Not provided", tostring(WorkstationName))
| where FailureCode =~ "0xc0000071"
| where isnotempty(RawSAMAccountName)
| where RawSAMAccountName !~ "ANONYMOUS LOGON"
| where not(RawSAMAccountName endswith "$")
| extend NormalisedSAM = NormalizeSam(RawSAMAccountName)
| summarize
    AttemptCount = count(),
    SrcHosts = make_set(SourceHost, 10),
    HostCount = dcount(SourceHost),
    FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated),
    LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated)
    by RawSAMAccountName, NormalisedSAM, FailureCode
| where AttemptCount > 20
| join kind=leftouter IdentityLookup on $left.NormalisedSAM == $right.NormalisedIdentitySAM
| extend AccountName = coalesce(IdentityAccountName, RawSAMAccountName)
| extend UserPrincipalName = IdentityUPN
| extend DisplayName = IdentityDisplayName
| extend SAMAccountName = coalesce(IdentitySAMAccountName, RawSAMAccountName)
| extend IdentityMatchStatus = iff(isnotempty(IdentitySAMAccountName), "Matched on IdentityInfo.SAMAccountName", "No IdentityInfo SAMAccountName match")
| extend FailureReason = "Expired password used for NTLM authentication"
| extend TimeSpanMinutes = datetime_diff("minute", LastSeen, FirstSeen)
| extend RecommendedReview = "Check for stale credentials in services, scheduled tasks, scripts, mapped drives, cached sessions, or applications on the listed source host(s). If unexpected, review for possible use of previously known credentials."
| project
    AccountName,
    DisplayName,
    UserPrincipalName,
    MailAddress,
    SAMAccountName,
    RawSAMAccountName,
    NormalisedSAM,
    IdentityMatchStatus,
    FailureCode,
    FailureReason,
    AttemptCount,
    HostCount,
    SrcHosts = tostring(SrcHosts),
    FirstSeen,
    LastSeen,
    TimeSpanMinutes,
    Department,
    JobTitle,
    Manager,
    AccountDomain = IdentityDomain,
    AccountSID,
    AccountObjectId,
    IsAccountEnabled,
    IsServiceAccount,
    SourceSystem,
    RecommendedReview
| order by AttemptCount desc

properties.description:

Detects potential exploitation attempts against CVE-2026-33824 vulnerable devices by monitoring for anomalous spikes 
in UDP traffic on IPSec ports (500/4500) from public IP addresses. The rule correlates devices marked as vulnerable 
with unusual network activity patterns that could indicate active exploitation attempts.

This detection uses baseline analysis to identify significant deviations from normal traffic patterns, focusing on:
- High volume of UDP events on ports 500/4500
- Unusual number of unique remote public IP addresses
- Traffic spikes exceeding historical baselines

CVE-2026-33824 may involve network-based attacks leveraging IPSec vulnerabilities, making this traffic analysis approach effective.
properties.query:
// CVE-2026-33824 exploitation detection via UDP traffic spike analysis
// Ensure all columns referenced in entityMappings, customDetails,
// and alertDetailsOverride exist in the query output.
let Lookback = 14d;
let DetectionWindow = 1h;
let MinEvents = 100;
let MinUniqueRemoteIPs = 20;
let SpikeMultiplier = 5.0;
let CVE = "CVE-2026-33824";
// Devices still marked vulnerable to CVE-2026-33824
let VulnerableDevices =
    DeviceTvmSoftwareVulnerabilities
    | where CveId == CVE
    | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by DeviceId
    | project DeviceId, CveId, VulnerabilitySeverityLevel, RecommendedSecurityUpdate;
// Historical hourly baseline for UDP 500/4500 traffic from public IPs
let Baseline =
    DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where TimeGenerated between (ago(Lookback) .. ago(DetectionWindow))
    | where Protocol =~ "Udp"
    | where LocalPort in (500, 4500)
    | where isnotempty(RemoteIP)
    | where RemoteIPType =~ "Public"
    | summarize HourlyEvents=count(), HourlyUniqueRemoteIPs=dcount(RemoteIP) by DeviceId, DeviceName, bin(TimeGenerated, 1h), LocalPort
    | summarize
        AvgHourlyEvents=avg(HourlyEvents),
        MaxHourlyEvents=max(HourlyEvents),
        AvgHourlyUniqueRemoteIPs=avg(HourlyUniqueRemoteIPs),
        MaxHourlyUniqueRemoteIPs=max(HourlyUniqueRemoteIPs)
        by DeviceId, DeviceName, LocalPort;
// Current detection window
let CurrentWindow =
    DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where TimeGenerated >= ago(DetectionWindow)
    | where Protocol =~ "Udp"
    | where LocalPort in (500, 4500)
    | where isnotempty(RemoteIP)
    | where RemoteIPType =~ "Public"
    | summarize
        StartTime=min(TimeGenerated),
        EndTime=max(TimeGenerated),
        EventCount=count(),
        UniqueRemoteIPs=dcount(RemoteIP),
        SampleRemoteIPs=make_set(RemoteIP, 20),
        SampleInitiatingProcesses=make_set(InitiatingProcessFileName, 10),
        SampleActions=make_set(ActionType, 10)
        by DeviceId, DeviceName, LocalPort;
CurrentWindow
| join kind=inner VulnerableDevices on DeviceId
| join kind=leftouter Baseline on DeviceId, DeviceName, LocalPort
| extend AvgHourlyEvents = coalesce(AvgHourlyEvents, 0.0)
| extend AvgHourlyUniqueRemoteIPs = coalesce(AvgHourlyUniqueRemoteIPs, 0.0)
| extend EventSpike = iff(AvgHourlyEvents == 0.0, todouble(EventCount), todouble(EventCount) / AvgHourlyEvents)
| extend RemoteIPSpike = iff(AvgHourlyUniqueRemoteIPs == 0.0, todouble(UniqueRemoteIPs), todouble(UniqueRemoteIPs) / AvgHourlyUniqueRemoteIPs)
| where EventCount >= MinEvents or UniqueRemoteIPs >= MinUniqueRemoteIPs
| where EventSpike >= SpikeMultiplier or RemoteIPSpike >= SpikeMultiplier or AvgHourlyEvents == 0.0
| extend AlertDetails = strcat("Device ", DeviceName, " vulnerable to ", CveId, " received ", EventCount, " UDP events from ", UniqueRemoteIPs, " unique public IPs on port ", LocalPort)
| project
    StartTime,
    EndTime,
    DeviceName,
    DeviceId,
    LocalPort,
    EventCount,
    UniqueRemoteIPs,
    EventSpike,
    RemoteIPSpike,
    SampleRemoteIPs,
    SampleInitiatingProcesses,
    SampleActions,
    CveId,
    VulnerabilitySeverityLevel,
    RecommendedSecurityUpdate,
    AlertDetails
| order by EventCount desc, UniqueRemoteIPs desc
